title: Classifieds listing card keeps its title readable when the price note is long

source.ref: Daniel screenshot 2026-10-20, Fix the marketplace display

detail: A long price note shared a no-wrap flex row with the title, so the title rendered one letter per line. The title and price row now wraps, the title keeps a 9rem floor and breaks long words, and a long price drops to its own line.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const c=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-b.css','utf8');const t=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/marketplace/item-grid.tsx','utf8');if(!c.includes('.fqm-item-head{flex-wrap:wrap')||!t.includes('fqm-item-head')){console.error('LIVE-1036: listing card title and price row can still squeeze the title');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the card head row is not allowed to wrap.
